subtitle: NJ scratch-off prize tracker
promotionalText: See which active New Jersey scratch-off games still have their top prizes, how the odds have shifted since launch, and what a ticket returns on average.
keywords: scratch off,scratchers,lottery,new jersey,instant games,prizes remaining,odds,expected value,tickets
description:
NJ Scratch turns the New Jersey Lottery's official remaining-prize data into clear, honest numbers for every active scratch-off game.

RANKINGS
Every active game gets a 0–100 score that compares its remaining official prizes with the other games on sale: estimated return per dollar, top and major prizes left relative to tickets sold, and the chance of winning more than the ticket costs. Filter by price, search by name or number, and sort the way you like.

GAME DETAILS
• Top, major and total prizes remaining, with the full prize table
• How the odds of the top prize have changed since launch
• Expected value and expected loss per ticket
• "If you buy several tickets": the chance of any prize, of a prize of $100, $1,000 or $10,000 or more, and of winning back more than you spend, shown next to the expected loss
• History charts and notable changes, such as top prizes claimed
• Other games at the same price with a stronger profile

CALENDAR
Newly announced games with their launch dates, games that stop selling next, and the last day to claim prizes on games that are no longer sold.

CHANGES AND WATCHLIST
Notable changes in the official data, grouped by day. Star games to follow them in your watchlist.

HONEST BY DESIGN
• Every formula is published, and estimates are labeled as estimates
• Works offline and shows how fresh the data is
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking, and no data collected

IMPORTANT
Scratch-off tickets are gambling. The lottery keeps a house edge, so every game returns less than it costs on average. Rankings describe official data; they are not predictions, and a high score doesn't mean a ticket is likely to win. You must be 18 or older to buy New Jersey Lottery tickets. If gambling is a problem, call 1-800-GAMBLER.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the New Jersey Lottery. The app does not sell tickets or accept wagers.
reviewNotes:
NJ Scratch is an information app. It analyzes the New Jersey Lottery's publicly available remaining-prize data for active scratch-off (instant) games, published at https://www.njlottery.com/api/v1/instant-games/games/ and mirrored as static JSON on our website (https://madramdesign.github.io/nj-scratch/).

The app does NOT sell lottery tickets, accept wagers or payments, link to ticket purchases, run contests, or offer prizes. It has no accounts, ads or in-app purchases, and collects no data. It is not affiliated with the New Jersey Lottery.

Responsible-gambling measures: a first-launch notice (gambling and house edge, rankings are not predictions, 18+ to buy tickets, 1-800-GAMBLER) that must be acknowledged; the same information on the About screen; expected loss shown next to every probability; no 'win' or 'hot game' language.

No login is needed. All features are available immediately after tapping 'I'm 18 or older, continue'.
